ref_date_note: Tue 12/9/2025 (posted Mon 12/8), subtitle 'Time to Give Back Today's Gains'. Z (Dec) contract per batch, no roll mention. Daily back in balance after cash sellers took out a prior-day low; NVDA news afterhours rip. ES today's low given as 6835.25 (Thursday's low 6836.25). ES abbreviations resolved to 68xx. es1: 'Short a fail of 66.5-69 or a LAAF which might come from 72-74' gated on 6866.5-6869 (72-74 noted in stop_hint); grade written 'Maybe a B/B- at best' -> 'B/B-'; '61 doesn't react' is a condition (stop_hint), targets 58 then 50.5-53. es2 grade written 'Simlar B/B- rating' (typo) -> 'B/B-'. es3 'Shorting a clear lower high below 50.5-53 is reasonable' ungraded, no target -> price commentary 'Below 50.5-53 finds 46 and opens a retest of today's low or at least 40-41.25' (6846, 6840-6841.25, 6835.25). NQ section has no grades (all tags ''). nq1 gate 688-700 ('fail or LAAF of 700 (I would really use 688-700)'); target 'around 657 but the weekly 651-669' -> 25657 (commentary: 'would retest likely the lower portion of the 651-669 range'). nq2 'One could consider shorting 724-730 ... front run the above' - targets taken as the above trade's zone/target (688-700, 657). nq3 'Long a hold of 651-669' has no target -> commentary levels up 688-700, 724-730, 761-769 ('Holding above 651-669 ... keeps open a retest of 761-769'). nq4 hold of 625-628 'iffy ... but it is valid' -> target 651-669. Opens to mark: ES 6pm Sunday 6883 / 09:30 Monday 6886, NQ 25750 / 25791 (kept as zones). Not transcribed: commentary expectations (sustaining below 6835.25 tests 6809.5-6812.5 unless 6828 traps; above 72-74 clean to 80-83 and today's open; persistent failures below 66.5-69 keep last week's low in play; NQ two relative equal daily highs above 761-769 as upside targets).
